vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 2.2.0

The skill is a legitimate Nginx configuration generator. The primary component, `scripts/nginx.sh`, provides templates for reverse proxies, SSL/HTTPS, static file serving, and security hardening using standard best practices (e.g., HSTS, security headers, and disabling version tokens). There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection intended to compromise the agent or the host system.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions are consistent with an nginx configuration generator — it doesn't request credentials, installers, or unusual system access, and the included shell script appears to only emit nginx config templates.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (nginx config generation: reverse proxy, SSL, caching, security, optimization) matches the provided content: SKILL.md lists related commands and the included scripts produce nginx configuration snippets. There are no unrelated env vars or binaries requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are template generation only. The SKILL.md is a short description and command cheat-sheet; the script builds config text based on flags and prints it. The instructions do not direct reading arbitrary user files, system secrets, or sending data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with a helper script). There is no remote download or package installation declared, so nothing is written to disk by an installer step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare or require environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script references common default certificate paths (e.g. /etc/letsencrypt/live) only as template placeholders — it does not read or exfiltrate them.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent/system-wide changes. There is no indication it modifies other skills or agent config, nor does it require elevated privileges to perform its stated function (it only emits config text).

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and focused on generating nginx config templates. Before running any scripts from an untrusted source, inspect the full scripts (the provided file content was truncated in the manifest excerpt) and avoid piping remote scripts directly to a shell or running them as root. Verify any file paths (e.g. /etc/letsencrypt/live) and only deploy generated configs after reviewing them for your environment. If you need higher assurance, run the script in a sandbox or on a non-production machine first.
